results.description:
It's all here
For over 30 years, eBay has been a leading online shopping destination and the trusted marketplace where millions of buyers and sellers connect every day. Whether you're looking to buy vintage fashion, electronics, shoes, clothes, rare, or hard-to-find items, you can get them on the eBay shopping app.

Discover collectibles, luxury handbags, jewelry, watches, trading cards, home goods, auto parts, refurbished tech, and everyday essentials. Whether you're shopping for vintage, pre-loved, or brand-new finds, millions of listings from trusted sellers make it easy to find exactly what you're looking for.

Stream it live
Experience the thrill of eBay Live. We’re bringing you live shopping, live auctions, and live bidding on one of the best live selling apps. Watch video streams, connect with the community, and discover exclusive drops. Bid to win rare trading cards, collectibles, vintage clothing, watches, sneakers, and more from trusted sellers. It’s all happening in real time on eBay Live right now.

Follow your favorite sellers, chat during live events, discover exclusive inventory, and join communities that share your interests. Whether you're into fashion, sneakers, collectibles, luxury, or trading cards, every live shopping experience offers something new.

Selling made easy
Turn your stuff into cash on the OG of selling apps. Join fellow eBay sellers on the resell marketplace they trust. Manage your eBay listings from the Seller Center or use the app for mobile selling from anywhere. eBay makes it easy to list.

Create a listing in a snap with the help of AI. Simply upload your photos, add your item description, and we’ll handle the rest. Sell fashion. Sell shoes. Sell pre-loved. On eBay, selling is easy.

Whether you're decluttering, starting a side hustle, or building a business, eBay gives sellers the tools to list faster, manage inventory, track orders, and connect with millions of buyers looking for fashion, electronics, collectibles, and more.

Shop with confidence
Millions trust eBay as their shopping marketplace of choice. We’ve got your back with buyer protections like eBay Money Back Guarantee and Authenticity Guarantee. Find authentic luxury watches, handbags, sneakers, trading cards and more checked by real  industry experts.

Discover real luxury handbags, watches, sneakers, and trading cards with peace of mind thanks to Authenticity Guarantee. Combined with eBay Money Back Guarantee, you can browse, bid, buy, and shop knowing you're protected every step of the way.

Get it your way
Customize your shopping experience with flexible shipping and delivery options, or choose local pickup. With saved searches, push notifications, personalized recommendations, and exclusive deals on your faves, the experience is tailored to you. Save money, discover trends, follow your favorite sellers, and never miss an auction or live event.

Compare prices, watch listings, save searches, receive alerts, and discover personalized recommendations across millions of items. From everyday shopping to one-of-a-kind finds, eBay helps you shop your way.

If you're looking to buy and sell things, eBay helps you connect with millions of buyers and sellers around the world. It’s a trusted marketplace—your online shopping destination for vintage fashion, electronics, shoes, clothing, and whatever you’re looking for. It’s more than thrifting. It’s more than secondhand shopping. It’s the place for new, pre-loved, vintage, and rare finds you can’t get anywhere else.

From vintage fashion and sneakers to collectibles, luxury items, electronics, home essentials, and more, eBay brings together buyers and sellers in one trusted marketplace. Discover great deals, shop your faves, and sell what you no longer need.

It’s a buying app, selling app, bidding app, auction app, and live shopping marketplace all in one. Download the eBay app today to search, shop, save, list, sell, and watch live. Buy and sell the things you love.

results.description:
Life’s easier in the eBay app! Buy and sell millions of items on the go. Discover exclusive online deals every single day.

Never miss a deal
With the eBay app, you can stay in the know with real-time alerts about your Daily Deals, order updates and more, all sent to your device with personalised push notifications.

Search, find and save faves
Experience game-changing shopping wherever you are:
● Shop by condition: From brand new to pre-loved fashion and Refurbished tech, find something that’s just right for you.
● Heart your faves: Stay in the loop on the latest drops and deals by adding them to your Watchlist.
● Search with pics: See something you like? Simply upload it with the push of a button and find matches instantly.

Planet-friendly shopping
Save money while discovering something truly unique when you shop for vintage and pre-loved finds. Plus, give great pieces a second life and help the planet while you’re at it. What’s not to love?

eBay Live exclusives
Your real-time shopping experience is here! Join the livestream for exclusive drops, live auctions, case breaks, and beyond. Connect with your community, fave sellers,
and creators for more of the things you love. 

Free selling
Clear out your space the easy way. Sell for free* and list your past loves with our handy AI tools. Plus, enjoy the benefits of Simple Delivery, including prepaid labels, automatic tracking and full protection for items lost or damaged in transit.
*Excludes Vehicles and business sellers.

Quickly list items with AI
Snap or upload a photo in the eBay app, then let AI instantly generate descriptions and key details for your listing, including brand, category and more. You can also add order tracking and chat with your community live.

Authenticity Guarantee
Shop with confidence. The Authenticity Guarantee tick means eligible trading cards, sneakers, watches and handbags will be inspected and verified by expert authenticators.

eBay Money Back Guarantee
Enjoy total peace of mind thanks to eBay Money Back Guarantee. With us, you’re covered. Get the item you ordered or your money back, it’s that simple.*

*For full eligibility criteria and all terms and conditions, visit:
https://pages.ebay.co.uk/ebay-money-back-guarantee/

Explore quick and easy payment options
We make it easy to pay for the things you want. Simply store your preferred payments safely and securely so you can check out in a flash!

Keep in touch
Your feedback is important to us. Contact us with any questions by joining the discussion at www.ebay.com/iOS.
